text:
tara: Lumen Finance returned the SecQ + POC checklist. They want SSO (SAML), SCIM provisioning, RBAC mappings, and domain verification. Need a single customer-ready response by EOD.

eli: Quick plan: send SAML SP metadata, ACS URLs, supported bindings (HTTP-POST, Redirect), required assertion attrs, cert fingerprint + rotation window.

eli: Minimal SAML attrs we expect:
```
NameID -> email
email -> urn:oid:0.9.2342.19200300.100.1.3
given_name -> givenName
family_name -> sn
groups -> groups
role -> custom:role
```

dan: Security: we require RSA-SHA256 signed assertions. SP-init + IdP-init supported. For the questionnaire include SOC2 reference, KMS/HSM support for Private, and audit log retention (90d default).

eli: SCIM notes: SCIM 2.0 users & groups, delta support, recommend scoped service account token for POC. Default rate limits: 5 RPS per tenant (burstable). Provide curl example: 
```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $SCIM_TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/scim+json" \
  -X POST https://api.redwood.example.com/scim/v2/Users -d '{"userName":"jane@lumen.com","name":{"givenName":"Jane","familyName":"Ops"}}'
```

maria: Commercials: offer 30d Hosted POC with credits + temporary support; separate quote for 3mo Dedicated eval (reserved capacity + onboarding). I'll draft both options.

tara: RBAC format ask: CSV or JSON with role_name, description, example_groups, allowed_routes. We'll supply a template.

eli: Sample RBAC snippet (flattened JSON rows for them to adapt):
[ {"role_name":"admin","example_groups":["infra-admins"],"allowed_routes":["/v1/*"]}, {"role_name":"viewer","example_groups":["auditors"],"allowed_routes":["/v1/usage"]} ]

dan: Domain proofing: DNS TXT record per tenant required. If they need domain-level routing or EU-only residency call out org-level settings and SRE enablement. Also note: CMK-backed encryption is Private only.

tara: Operational checklist for POC we need from Lumen: (1) IdP metadata file, (2) SCIM token + sample user list, (3) RBAC mapping file, (4) DNS TXT proof domain.

maria: I'll attach pricing + sample SOW to the outbound.

dan: Uploading security one-pager and cert rotation doc. Add me for legal follow-ups.

eli: I'll put together a concise SAML/SCIM quickstart with sample configs and the RBAC CSV template.

infra-bot: artifacts deployed: staging/poc-templates @3995003350

tara: Thanks. I'll reply to the AE and propose a 10am PT technical sync tomorrow to walk SAML/SCIM; say +1 if you can join.

eli: +1

maria: +1

dan: +1

tara: scheduling now and will CC their IdP admin.
